notes.title: Version 11 Update
notes.content: [p]Yet another big-ish update. I'm actually happy with how little time it took me to make this compared to the previous bigger update[/p][list][*][p]New map[/p][/*][*][p]Added building[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Acid lake map[/p][list][*][p]Ground texture[/p][/*][*][p]Added some details outside the playable space[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with enemies getting stuck under the Acid[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed you being unable to pick up the Railgun[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated the tutorial[/p][list][*][p]Added a building section to the tutorial[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated the City map[/p][list][*][p]Fixed secret weapon pickups not working[/p][/*][*][p]Added a buyable wall in the top building passage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated the test map[/p][list][*][p]All weapons (besides the grappling hook) have icons now[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed the laggy camera when driving the buggy on the test map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some weapons being stuck in a state where you can't fire them[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how the electric zombie works (It now follows other enemies before starting to target you)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a lot of achievements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Enjoy :3c![/p]

- Fixed you being unable to pick up the Railgun
